hero.title: Simple, transparent pricing
hero.subtitle: Start in the sandbox for free. Scale with usage-based plans that include security, compliance, and human-in-the-loop controls.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.summary: Evaluate workflows with up to 3 team members.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.summary: Joint roadmap, private networking, on-prem options.

faq.question: How does metered usage work?
faq.answer: You pay for workflow executions and runtime hours. Starter includes 5K executions / month; Growth and Enterprise include volume discounts.

faq.question: Can I deploy in my own cloud?
faq.answer: Yes. Growth supports dedicated clusters; Enterprise supports private networks, on-prem deployments, and custom data residency.

faq.question: Do you offer compliance support?
faq.answer: We provide SOC2-ready audit logging, access controls, and policy templates. Enterprise plans include compliance automation and shared controls.

faq.question: What support is included?
faq.answer: Starter includes community support. Growth adds 24/7 email + chat. Enterprise adds dedicated success engineers and migration support.

cta.title: Need a custom package?
cta.subtitle: We can bundle multi-environment deployments, private networking, and joint roadmap commitments.
